universities.name: Arul Tharum VPMM College of Engineering and Technology
universities.summary: Arul Tharum VPMM College of Engineering and Technology (VPMM), formerly V.P. Muthaiah Pillai Meenakshi Ammal Engineering College for Women, is a private self-financing engineering college founded in 2002 at Krishnankoil, Virudhunagar district, Tamil Nadu. It is an Anna University-affiliated college, and Anna University awards its degrees. It admits men and women to six AICTE-approved B.E./B.Tech branches.
universities.campusLifestyle: Arul Tharum VPMM College of Engineering and Technology (VPMM)'s 2026-27 AICTE disclosure lists 27 classrooms of 70.08 sq m, 12 tutorial rooms, 21 laboratories including an English language laboratory, two computer centres and 1,000 Mbps internet bandwidth, with lifts in all blocks. The library holds 24,331 books in 6,620 titles and subscribes to DELNET and the National Digital Library. The disclosure also lists an innovation cell, sports facilities and one MoU, with Ekalai Academy, Coimbatore.
universities.cityProfile: Arul Tharum VPMM College of Engineering and Technology (VPMM) is at V.P.M. Nagar, Krishnankoil, in Srivilliputtur taluk of Virudhunagar district, Tamil Nadu (AICTE address PIN 626190). The college's trust, the V.P. Muthaiah Pillai Meenakshi Ammal Trust, is registered at 40 North Car Street, Srivilliputtur. Kalasalingam Academy of Research and Education, a separate deemed university, is also at Krishnankoil. Anna University lists VPMM under its Tirunelveli region, Virudhunagar district.
universities.practicalExposure: Arul Tharum VPMM College of Engineering and Technology (VPMM) teaches Anna University's curricula: the university sets the syllabus, conducts end-semester exams and awards the degree, and the college runs internal assessments. AICTE makes an internship mandatory for every admitted student, and Anna University's 2025 regulations give one credit for each two weeks of internship. The college's placement training covers mock interviews, aptitude tests, group discussions and soft-skills workshops. Its 2026-27 disclosure lists one industry MoU, with Ekalai Academy, Coimbatore, and reports no enrolment and placement figures, research projects or consultancy for the last three years. No VPMM programme is NBA-accredited.
universities.hostelOverview: Arul Tharum VPMM College of Engineering and Technology (VPMM) has a boys' hostel and a girls' hostel on campus, according to its 2026-27 AICTE disclosure. The college's hostel page lists rooms for 2 to 4 students with cots, study tables, wardrobes and fans, Wi-Fi, laundry service, a gym and a TV room. The college publishes no hostel or mess fee, and TNEA's 2026 college booklet has no entry for VPMM, so ask the college for current charges.
universities.dietarySupport: Arul Tharum VPMM College of Engineering and Technology (VPMM)'s hostel mess serves vegetarian and non-vegetarian food, according to the college's hostel page. No menu, mess fee or provision for specific regional or religious diets is published, so ask the hostel office before joining.
universities.safetyOverview: Arul Tharum VPMM College of Engineering and Technology (VPMM)'s 2026-27 anti-ragging committee is chaired by the principal and includes a Deputy Superintendent of Police and a Sub-Inspector from Srivilliputhur, an NGO representative and a parent. The college also lists an internal committee on sexual harassment and an SC/ST committee. The hostel page lists 24-hour security, CCTV and biometric entry.
universities.studentSupport: Arul Tharum VPMM College of Engineering and Technology (VPMM) takes grievances through an online form and a four-member grievance committee. The college lists Tamil Nadu scholarships for SC/ST/SCC, hostel students (HESS, family income up to INR 2,00,000) and minority students, plus management scholarships for toppers and poorer students. Contact: info@vpmm.in or +91 89258 04367.

AICTE approves six B.E./B.Tech branches for 2026-27 (Civil, CSE, ECE, EEE, IT, and AI and Data Science), all offered in TNEA 2026 under code 4979 and all leading to an Anna University degree.

faq.question: Is VPMM Engineering College AICTE approved?
faq.answer: Yes, Arul Tharum VPMM College of Engineering and Technology (VPMM) is AICTE approved: it is on AICTE's 2026-27 list of approved institutions as a private self-financing college, permanent ID 1-8897103. AICTE approves six B.E./B.Tech branches and two M.E. programmes there for 2026-27, all under Anna University, Chennai.

faq.question: What is the TNEA code for VPMM?
faq.answer: The TNEA counselling code for Arul Tharum VPMM College of Engineering and Technology (VPMM) is 4979, and its Anna University examination code is 9535. In TNEA 2026 the college offered Civil (CE), CSE (CS), ECE (EC), EEE (EE), IT and AI and Data Science (AD) seats.

faq.question: Is VPMM a women's college?
faq.answer: No, Arul Tharum VPMM College of Engineering and Technology (VPMM) is no longer a women-only college, although it was formerly V.P. Muthaiah Pillai Meenakshi Ammal Engineering College for Women. AICTE's 2026-27 list does not mark it as a women's institution, and its 2026-27 disclosure lists both a boys' hostel and a girls' hostel.

faq.question: Is V.P. Muthaiah Pillai Meenakshi Ammal Engineering College the same as Arul Tharum VPMM?
faq.answer: Yes, Arul Tharum VPMM College of Engineering and Technology (VPMM) is the renamed V.P. Muthaiah Pillai Meenakshi Ammal Engineering College for Women at V.P.M. Nagar, Krishnankoil, near Srivilliputtur. Anna University lists it under the new name with "formerly" the old one, and AICTE keeps the same permanent ID, 1-8897103.

faq.question: Is VPMM part of the Kalasalingam group?
faq.answer: No, Arul Tharum VPMM College of Engineering and Technology (VPMM) is not part of the Kalasalingam group: it is run by the V.P. Muthaiah Pillai Meenakshi Ammal Trust of Srivilliputtur. Kalasalingam Academy of Research and Education is a separate deemed university in the same village, Krishnankoil, with its own AICTE record and its own trust.

faq.question: What is the fee at VPMM Engineering College?
faq.answer: Arul Tharum VPMM College of Engineering and Technology (VPMM)'s 2026-27 AICTE disclosure lists tuition of INR 50,000 a year for government-quota (TNEA) seats and INR 85,000 a year for management-quota seats. It publishes no hostel, mess or transport charges. TNEA entrants may claim the First Graduate concession, the AICTE Tuition Fee Waiver or the Post-Matric Scholarship.

faq.question: Can NRI or international students apply to VPMM?
faq.answer: No, Arul Tharum VPMM College of Engineering and Technology (VPMM) has no NRI or foreign-national seats on AICTE's 2026-27 list, and its 2025-26 approval shows NRI and foreign quotas as No. TNEA is for Indian nationals; OCI/PIO card holders who are natives of Tamil Nadu may join unless born abroad after 4 March 2021.

faq.question: How do I get admission to VPMM?
faq.answer: Most seats at Arul Tharum VPMM College of Engineering and Technology (VPMM) are filled through TNEA: register at tneaonline.org, get a rank from Mathematics (100), Physics (50) and Chemistry (50), and choose code 4979. TNEA 2026 counselling ran 20 July to 30 August, and Anna University classes began on 2 September 2026. Management-quota seats are applied for at the college.

faq.question: Is VPMM NBA or NAAC accredited?
faq.answer: No, Arul Tharum VPMM College of Engineering and Technology (VPMM) is not NBA or NAAC accredited: its 2026-27 AICTE disclosure lists no NBA-accredited programme, and no NAAC grade is reported. Its recognition is AICTE approval and Anna University affiliation.

faq.question: Does VPMM have hostels?
faq.answer: Yes, Arul Tharum VPMM College of Engineering and Technology (VPMM) has separate on-campus hostels for men and women, with rooms for 2 to 4 students and a mess serving vegetarian and non-vegetarian food. The college publishes no hostel or mess fee.
